hypothesis: A modern conflict-driven SAT solver with a full one-hot mark encoding and explicit difference-occurrence at-most-one clauses can resolve the complete scope-111 DTS decision problem within a bounded Linux run, producing either a validator-accepted witness or a definitive solver status.
rationale: Prior CP-SAT and Z3 direct models returned UNKNOWN, and Glucose4 timed out on a smaller radius-3 neighborhood. Kissat is a materially different high-performance CDCL capability. The new encoding exposes every mark choice as Boolean, propagates strict order directly, breaks row permutation symmetry, and encodes exact global difference uniqueness without relying on sampled row catalogues or a local repair basin.
expected_information_gain: Distinguishes the previously unresolved full target from solver/encoding limitations. SAT yields a true-objective candidate if independently valid; UNSAT would prove only the frozen finite scope-111 decision instance infeasible; UNKNOWN is runtime evidence only.
method: Generate a DIMACS CNF for all seven normalized six-mark rows with positive marks one-hot in 1..111, adjacent strict-order clauses, nondecreasing first-mark row symmetry, one auxiliary literal for each possible within-row difference occurrence, and pairwise at-most-one constraints across all occurrences of each difference. Run Kissat 4.0.3 under WSL2 Ubuntu with a 120-second solver limit. Decode any SAT model and independently validate it with the repository integer verifier.
metric: SAT status, formula size, elapsed time, decoded rows, and independent DTS validity
metric_relation_to_true_objective: A decoded assignment accepted by the independent integer verifier with scope<=111 is exactly true-objective progress. UNSAT establishes finite full-instance infeasibility only; UNKNOWN or timeout establishes no mathematical infeasibility.

configuration.encoding: one-hot marks plus explicit difference-occurrence auxiliaries and pairwise at-most-one

kill_condition: Stop at SAT, UNSAT, or the 120-second Kissat limit plus bounded process cleanup. Do not infer mathematical infeasibility from UNKNOWN or timeout.

baseline_comparison.expected_relation: strict improvement only if SAT model passes independent verifier

previous_best_comparison.expected_relation: new solver capability and full-target Boolean encoding

interpretation: This is a preregistration only; no result exists before execution.
recommended_next_action: Run the declared full-target Kissat solve, independently verify any decoded model, and preserve the formula and raw solver output.
repetition_justification: This is not a repeat of CP-SAT, Z3, Glucose4 radius-3 SAT, random catalogues, or finite row repair: it changes both the solver capability and the encoding to a full-domain one-hot CDCL formulation.
